purpose: Qualify bounded delivered-plan geometry as robot-visible evidence for a path-decision explanation on one previously unrun development layout.
robot_visible_evidence: delivered Nav2 plan hashes, lengths, timestamps, and signed/absolute deviation from the requested start-goal line
exact runtime source and configuration hashes
evaluator_only: semantic obstacle identities and canonical geometry

admission.recording_valid: fixture validity and runtime/source hash gates pass; plan summaries contain valid sha256 IDs and finite nonnegative geometry; evaluator truth remains separate

allowed_conclusions: the fixture received one or more global plans whose measured geometry departed from the requested direct start-goal line
delivered odometry followed a measured non-direct trajectory when that observation is present
the navigation action's recorded terminal outcome
prohibited_conclusions: a particular evaluator-only obstacle caused a plan or trajectory change
the controller consumed a delivered global plan
Nav2 consumed the retained costmap snapshot
temporal association proves a physical causal relationship

analysis.statistical_status: one development instrumentation-qualification run; not pooled with the frozen legacy study and not held-out
